children.text: Review samples, refine labels, and build approved training snapshots.
Review source evidence, refine labels, and freeze approved snapshots.
classification · Imported model drafts · 2/6 cycles closed
Closing freezes approved labels. Rejected and skipped samples are excluded. Later cycles append to the cumulative snapshot.
Reviewing includes accepted, corrected, rejected, and skipped decisions.
0 loaded tasks; latest review per sample.
